description: Make images smaller, by quality or to a target file size (e.g. under 500 KB for a form). Keeps each file’s format unless asked; files that already fit are left as they are; PNGs reach a size by reducing colours. Saved next to the originals as name-compressed.ext.

allow_resize.description: To a size: may an image be scaled down if even low quality is too big?

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

format.description: Output format. "original" keeps each file’s own (HEIC, AVIF and TIFF become JPEG, GIF becomes PNG).

max_edge.description: Scale down so the longest side is at most this many pixels (never enlarged).

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

quality.description: Quality when not compressing to a size (30–100). For PNG, below 100 reduces colours.

target_kb.description: Largest allowed size in KB. Leave out to compress by quality instead.

name: compress_images
title: Compress images
